title: Feandrea Foldable Travel Crate for Dogs and Cats, 60cm, Grey
description:
## About the Feandrea Foldable Travel Crate

The Feandrea Foldable Travel Crate is a soft-sided carrier for pet owners who want something sturdier than a simple bag-style carrier but still easy to fold away between trips. A lightweight steel frame keeps its shape while your pet is inside, and the whole crate collapses flat to roughly 60cm x 42cm x 8cm when you are done, so it tucks into a car boot or cupboard without taking up permanent space.

It suits [small dogs](/carriers/dog-carriers/small-dog-carriers) in the 7 to 11kg range, as well as cats who prefer a roomier, more open carrier than a hard box style. Because it opens out into a proper crate shape rather than a narrow bag, pets have enough room to turn around, lie down and settle in for longer journeys.

## Key Features

### Steel Frame with Fold-Flat Design

A metal frame supports the 600D Oxford fabric body, so the crate holds its shape properly while your pet is inside rather than collapsing in on them. Once you are finished, unclip the frame and it folds flat for storage.

### Mesh Doors and Windows

Mesh panels run along the doors and windows, giving your dog or cat a good view out and steady airflow. This also helps nervous pets feel less shut in, since they can see you are close by.

### Storage Pockets

Two side pockets built into the crate hold small items such as a lead, treats or a water bottle, so there is no need to carry a separate bag for short trips.

### Removable Base Mat

A soft, easy-clean mat lines the base for comfort. Lift it out between uses to keep the crate fresh.

## Who This Crate Is Best For

This [dog carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers) and [cat carrier](/carriers/cat-carriers) suits:

- Small to medium dogs weighing roughly 7 to 11kg (Toy Poodles, Corgis, French Bulldogs and similar breeds)
- Cats who prefer more room to move than a hard box-style carrier
- [Car travel](/carriers/car-travel-carriers) and [vet visits](/carriers/vet-visit-carriers), thanks to the fold-flat storage
- Camping trips, hotel stays or as an occasional indoor den at home
- Owners who want a [soft-sided carrier](/carriers/soft-sided-carriers) that still holds its shape properly

## Care Instructions

Wipe down the fabric exterior with a damp cloth. Lift out the base mat to shake off loose hair and spot clean as needed. Let everything dry fully before folding away, to stop any musty smell developing in storage.

## About the Lionto Foldable Dog Crate

The Lionto Foldable Dog Crate is a fabric and steel-tube crate designed for car travel, house training and everyday resting at home. Oxford fabric stretched over a lightweight steel frame keeps the crate stable while your dog is inside, and it folds down flat when you do not need it, so it does not take up permanent floor space.

A padded reclining cushion with a removable cover lines the base, giving your dog a comfortable spot to settle whether you are on a long drive or they are having a quiet nap at home. Because the crate keeps its shape and has a defined sleeping area, it also works well as part of house training, since most puppies avoid soiling the space they sleep in.

## Key Features

### Steel Tube Frame

Durable, lightweight steel tubes support the fabric body, so the crate holds its shape properly rather than sagging once your dog climbs in.

### Mesh Windows and Zip Access

Mesh netting on the sides and front gives good airflow and lets your dog see out, while zips at the top and front make it easy to get them in and out.

### Padded Cushion Base

A cosy reclining cushion with a removable cover sits inside the base. Take it out to freshen up between uses.

### Fold-Flat Storage

When you do not need the crate, it folds flat for easy storage in a car boot, cupboard or under a bed.

### Carry Handle and Side Pockets

A sturdy carry handle makes it easy to move between the car and the house, and two side pockets hold small items like treats or a lead.

## Who This Crate Is Best For

This [dog carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers) suits:

- Small to medium dogs who need a stable, comfortable crate for car journeys
- Puppies going through house training, thanks to the defined sleeping area
- Owners who want a [car travel](/carriers/car-travel-carriers) crate that doubles as an everyday resting spot at home
- Trips to the [vet](/carriers/vet-visit-carriers) or short stays away from home
- Anyone who wants a crate that folds away flat rather than a rigid plastic carrier taking up storage space

## Care Instructions

Remove the cushion cover and wash it separately according to its care label. Wipe the fabric shell with a damp cloth and let everything dry fully before folding the crate away for storage.

## About the Conlun Collapsible Carrier

The Conlun Collapsible Carrier is a soft-sided bag-style carrier built for large cats and small to medium dogs up to 10kg. A steel frame inside the polyester body keeps its shape in use, while self-locking zippers mean your pet cannot nudge their way out mid-journey. It is designed for car rides and everyday trips rather than air travel, so it suits owners who need a comfortable, secure carrier for local journeys, vet visits and days out.

It works well as a carrier for larger cat breeds who need a bit more room, and as a small dog carrier for puppies and smaller adult dogs. Always measure your pet's length, height and weight against the carrier's dimensions before buying, to make sure they will be comfortable inside.

## Key Features

### Self-Locking Zippers and Safety Leash

The main zippers lock shut so an inquisitive pet cannot work them open from the inside. An internal safety leash clips onto a harness or collar for extra reassurance during the journey.

### Breathable Mesh on Three Sides

Mesh panels on three sides and an openable top let fresh air in and give your pet a view out, which helps keep them settled rather than feeling shut away.

### External Storage Pockets

Pockets on the outside of the carrier hold small essentials like treats, a lead or waste bags, so you do not need to carry a separate bag for short trips.

### Removable, Washable Base Mat

A soft fleece mat lines the base for comfort and lifts out for hand or machine washing.

### Padded Strap and Carry Handles

Carry it by the top handles or use the adjustable, padded shoulder strap for hands-free trips.

## Who This Carrier Is Best For

- Large cat breeds who need more room than a standard cat carrier
- Small to medium dogs and puppies up to around 10kg
- Car journeys and vet visits
- Owners who want a soft-sided carrier that still holds its shape
- Everyday errands where a lightweight, foldable carrier is easier to store between trips

This carrier is not certified for air travel, so it is best kept for car journeys and everyday outings rather than flights.

## Care Instructions

Wipe the polyester exterior down with a damp cloth. Remove the fleece base mat to hand wash or machine wash on a gentle cycle, and let it dry fully before folding the carrier away for storage.

## About the DPWEION Foldable Pet Carrier

The DPWEION carrier is a soft-sided, foldable travel bag built for [small dogs](/carriers/dog-carriers/small-dog-carriers) and cats who need a comfortable, secure way to get from A to B. A steel frame and wooden support board keep the bag's shape steady rather than collapsing in on your pet, while mesh panels on all four sides let air circulate and give your pet a clear view out.

It suits pets up to around 7.3kg (16lbs), though as with any carrier it is worth checking your pet's length and height as well as their weight before choosing a size. The [soft-sided](/carriers/soft-sided-carriers) design folds flat for storage between trips, and a front pocket keeps small essentials like treats or a lead close to hand.

## Key Features

### Steel Frame with Four-Sided Mesh

A sturdy steel frame and wooden support board hold the carrier's shape, so it does not sag or wobble when your pet moves around inside. Mesh windows on all four sides keep air moving and let your pet see their surroundings, which can help them feel less closed in during the journey.

### Airline-Sized and Car Ready

The carrier is sized to fit under most aeroplane seats and includes four non-slip feet to help stop it sliding around in a car or on a bus seat. It can also be fastened using a car seatbelt for secure [car travel](/carriers/car-travel-carriers), or the adjustable shoulder strap, giving you a couple of ways to keep it steady on the move.

### Removable, Washable Pad

The soft pad inside lifts out for washing, and the outer fabric wipes clean with a damp cloth, so everyday muck from paws or accidents is easy to deal with.

### Folds Flat with a Front Pocket

When it is not in use, the carrier folds down flat to save space in a cupboard or car boot. A front pocket gives you somewhere to keep small items like treats, poo bags or a spare lead.

## Who This Carrier Is Best For

This carrier suits:

- Small dogs and cats up to around 7.3kg (16lbs)
- Owners taking car journeys who want a carrier that can be belted in securely
- Owners who want a soft, foldable [cat carrier](/carriers/cat-carriers) rather than a rigid box carrier
- Nervous pets who benefit from mesh windows on every side for airflow and visibility
- Anyone who wants a carrier that folds away flat between trips

## Care Instructions

Remove the internal pad and wash it according to the care label, then leave it to dry fully before putting it back in the carrier. Wipe the outer fabric down with a damp cloth for everyday marks, and let the whole carrier air dry before folding it away, to avoid a musty smell building up in storage.

title: PetAmi Front Carrier Backpack for Dogs and Cats
description:
## About the PetAmi Front Carrier Backpack

The PetAmi Front Carrier Backpack is built for owners who want their small dog or cat close by on every outing, whether that's a countryside walk, a cycle ride or a weekend of camping. Worn on your front or back, it keeps your pet secure against your body while leaving both your hands free, which makes it a genuinely practical [hiking dog carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers/hiking-dog-carriers) for longer routes where a lead alone isn't always practical. The ventilated panel design gives your pet a steady flow of fresh air throughout the trip, rather than feeling shut away in a stuffy bag.

It's sized for pets up to around 4.5kg (10lbs), so it suits [small dogs](/carriers/dog-carriers/small-dog-carriers) such as Chihuahuas, small terriers and toy breeds, as well as cats who are happy being carried close to your chest. The padded, adjustable straps mean the carrier can be fitted to different body shapes, and a side expansion panel gives a little extra room once your pet is settled inside, rather than leaving them squeezed into a fixed space for the whole trip.

## Key Features and Benefits

### Front-Worn, Hands-Free Design

Wearing your pet on your front keeps them close and visible at all times, which many pets find reassuring compared with being carried at arm's length in a shoulder bag. With both your hands free, you can manage a lead for a second dog, hold walking poles or simply keep your balance on uneven ground.

### Adjustable and Expandable Fit

Shoulder straps, a waist strap and extra buckles let you fine-tune the fit for your own build, while thick foam padding cushions your shoulders and back on longer outings. A side panel expands slightly once your pet is inside, giving them a touch more room to settle without needing to size up the whole carrier.

### Safety Strap and Reflective Trim

An internal safety strap and buckle attach to your pet's harness or collar, giving an extra layer of security against wriggling free mid-walk. Reflective trim around the outside of the bag helps you stay visible to traffic and other walkers during early morning or evening trips out.

### Poop Bag Dispenser and Storage Pockets

A built-in poop bag dispenser and a front pocket, plus two side mesh pockets, mean you can carry treats, a water bottle and clean-up bags without needing a separate bag. Everything you need for a short trip stays within easy reach rather than stuffed into your own pockets.

## Who This Carrier Is Best For

This front carrier suits:

- Small dog breeds up to around 4.5kg (10lbs), including Chihuahuas, Yorkshire Terriers and similar toy breeds
- Cats who are used to being held and enjoy being close to you, a comfortable [cat backpack](/carriers/cat-carriers/cat-backpack-carriers) alternative for confident cats
- Owners who want a [dog backpack carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers/dog-backpack-carriers) that keeps hands free for cycling or walking more than one pet at once
- Shorter trips out and about where a fully enclosed carrier feels unnecessary

## Care Instructions

Wipe the outer fabric down with a damp cloth after muddy walks, and leave the carrier to air dry fully before folding it away. The mesh ventilation panels can collect loose fur, so a quick brush or a vacuum with a soft attachment keeps airflow clear. Avoid machine washing, as this can affect the padding and strap stitching over time. Check the buckles and safety strap periodically for wear, particularly if your pet is a determined wriggler, and stop using the carrier if any stitching around the straps starts to fray.

title: Nasjac Adjustable Dog Carrier Backpack
description:
## About the Nasjac Dog Carrier Backpack

The Nasjac Dog Carrier Backpack is a front-worn carrier built with a roomier, more open interior than many chest carriers, giving your dog space to shift position rather than feeling wedged in. Large mesh panels run across the design to maximise airflow, which helps keep your dog cool and settled during hiking, walking or travel, and the whole bag is available in four sizes so you can match it properly to your dog rather than sizing up or down from a single fixed option.

Buckles secure the front chest, side legs and your own waist, so once your dog's limbs and tail are positioned correctly, the safety buckle and adjustable straps hold everything in place for the rest of your walk. It works well as a general-purpose [hiking dog carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers/hiking-dog-carriers) or as a lighter [dog backpack carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers/dog-backpack-carriers) for shorter daily outings, and the whole thing is machine washable for easy cleaning after muddy trips.

## Key Features and Benefits

### Spacious, Breathable Interior

A roomier design than many front carriers reduces restlessness by giving your dog space to move slightly rather than feeling pinned in place. Large mesh panels keep air circulating throughout the carrier during hiking, walking or travel.

### Four Sizes and Three Colours

Available in S, M, L and XL, sized for [small dogs](/carriers/dog-carriers/small-dog-carriers) through to [medium dogs](/carriers/dog-carriers/medium-dog-carriers), so you can choose a genuinely well-fitted carrier rather than making do with a single generic size.

### Secure Multi-Point Buckle System

Buckles at the front chest, side legs and your waist work together to keep your dog held securely in place, with a fabric-covered elastic band adding flexibility without letting your dog break free during a struggle.

### Thickened Foam Padding

Foam pads throughout the carrier give a soft, supportive feel without unnecessary bulk, helping to reduce stress on both you and your dog across a longer trip out.

### Lightweight and Machine Washable

The carrier is genuinely light to wear over a full walk, and being machine washable makes it easy to keep fresh after muddy trails or a trip to the beach.

## Who This Carrier Is Best For

This carrier suits:

- Small to medium dogs across four available sizes, always measure your dog and compare against the size chart before ordering
- Owners who want a well-ventilated carrier for longer routes and warmer weather
- Everyday walks, camping trips and travel days where a machine-washable design makes upkeep simple
- Dogs who settle better with a little extra room to shift position, rather than a snug, fixed-shape bag

## Care Instructions

The Nasjac carrier is machine washable, so remove any detachable padding first and check the care label before washing on a gentle cycle. Air dry fully rather than tumble drying, to protect the foam padding and elastic band inside. Wipe down the mesh panels with a damp cloth between full washes to keep them clear of loose fur and everyday dirt. Inspect the buckles and elastic band periodically, particularly if your dog is a strong puller, and stop using the carrier if any stitching or buckle shows signs of wear.

description:
## About the DOBVDLA Dog Front Carrier Backpack

The DOBVDLA Dog Front Carrier Backpack is built with wide, extra-thick shoulder pads and two adjustable horizontal straps, aimed at owners carrying a slightly heavier dog rather than just a small toy breed. The ergonomic design spreads your dog's weight more evenly across your shoulders, which makes a real difference on longer outings compared with a basic sling-style bag. It works well as a general-purpose [hiking dog carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers/hiking-dog-carriers), suited to dogs up to around 15.9kg (35lbs), covering everything from [small dogs](/carriers/dog-carriers/small-dog-carriers) through to many [medium dogs](/carriers/dog-carriers/medium-dog-carriers).

A cut-out tail hole and a cushioned seat area give your dog somewhere comfortable to sit rather than being squeezed into a flat pouch, while soft padding around the chest and collar area shifts pressure away from your dog's throat. The adjustable buckle design means it goes on and comes off quickly, which is particularly useful for older or less mobile dogs who might struggle with a fiddly zipped carrier.

## Key Features and Benefits

### Ergonomic, Wide Shoulder Straps

Extra-wide, thickly padded shoulder straps and two horizontal adjustment straps spread your dog's weight evenly and stop the carrier slipping mid-walk, reducing the shoulder ache that comes with narrower, less padded designs.

### Built for Small to Medium Dogs

Rated for dogs up to around 15.9kg (35lbs), with your dog's back length and chest girth as the key measurements to check before ordering, so you get a genuinely secure, well-fitted carry rather than a loose or overly tight one.

### Tail Hole and Cushioned Seat

A dedicated tail hole and a cushioned area where your dog sits add a level of comfort and practicality that flatter, pouch-style carriers don't offer, letting your dog settle into a more natural position.

### Quick-Adjust Buckle Fastening

An adjustable buckle design avoids the fur-snagging that zipped carriers are prone to, and makes it faster to get your dog settled, which is especially handy for older dogs or those less keen on being handled for long.

## Who This Carrier Is Best For

This carrier suits:

- Small to medium dogs up to around 15.9kg (35lbs), always measure your dog's back length and chest girth first
- Owners who want a supportive, padded carrier for longer walks without shoulder strain
- Older or less mobile dogs who benefit from a quick, fuss-free buckle fastening rather than a zip
- Front or back carrying, depending on which feels more comfortable for you and your dog

## Care Instructions

Wipe the outer fabric down with a damp cloth after use, paying particular attention to the mesh back panel where fur and dirt tend to collect. Allow the carrier to dry fully before folding it away for storage. Avoid machine washing, to protect the padding and buckle stitching. Check the horizontal adjustment straps and buckles periodically for wear, especially if your dog is towards the upper end of the weight range, and stop using the carrier if any strap shows signs of fraying.
